title: SLM-CPU-0 Arduino Core
subtitle: FACTS:stm32 Arduino platform and slm-cpu-0-netflash Ethernet uploader
advisorySource: OSV via osv-scanner (aggregates the Go vulnerability database and the GitHub Advisory Database)
_note_ids: Every triage entry lists the advisory ids it accounts for. build-report.mjs cross-checks the live post-suppression scan against these: an advisory no entry claims is reported in section 4a as untriaged instead of being silently omitted.
_note_counts: advisories/counts describe the last FULL assessment (assessedAt) and are only rendered when the report is built without a live scan. With --osv-raw/--osv-delta the numbers come from that run.
headline: No advisory has been triaged for this repository yet. The numbers in the Key metrics table come from this run's scan; any advisory it reports is listed in section 4a until it is triaged.
scope: This repository builds the FACTS:stm32 Arduino platform for the Synergy Logic SLM-CPU-0 (STM32F407) and its Ethernet uploader slm-cpu-0-netflash, a Go program shipped as a board manager tool for five hosts. The platform archive bundles a trimmed STM32duino core, STM32Ethernet and LwIP with local changes; the Arm GCC toolchain, CMSIS and STM32Tools are referenced from the board manager index at their upstream URLs.
scopeNote: The automated scan covers the Go module of the uploader (tools/slm-cpu-0-netflash/go.mod, standard library only). The upstream C/C++ sources and toolchains pinned in tools/ci/upstream.json are inventoried in the SBOM from security/components.json but are not in any OSV ecosystem, so advisories against them are triaged by hand. The Go standard library version compiled into the uploader is not read from go.mod by the scanner.
methodologyNote: Advisories were obtained from OSV via osv-scanner, honoring the suppression baseline in osv-scanner.toml. The upstream archives are downloaded at the versions and SHA-256 digests pinned in tools/ci/upstream.json.
licenseNote: The repository and the uploader are GPL-3.0. Bundled upstream code keeps its licences (LGPL-2.1, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0); see NOTICE.md and the components CSV of the release SBOM.
criticalNote: No critical advisory has been triaged for this repository.
remediation: No action recorded. Triage any advisory listed in section 4a.

practices.practice: Upstream archives pinned by version and SHA-256 (tools/ci/upstream.json)
SBOM generated per release in CycloneDX and SPDX
CI security gate runs on every pull request and reports newly-introduced critical advisories
Automated advisory matching for the upstream C/C++ components
That gate configured as a required status check, so it blocks the merge
